source: codex/route-a-system-optimization uncommitted candidate; fixed runtime-rc4/Node and same owned synthetic profile
comparison: Baseline Go overlay changes only the desktop attach call from AttachHostForWorkspace to AttachHost; deferred candidate uses current source. One prewarm, one baseline warm, one deferred warm; no Node profiler.
productDecision: Retain workspace-priority inventory scheduling. It removes inventory competition with connection bootstrap without discarding work; explicit management/A2 can load before workspace and ordinary eager AttachHost remains unchanged.
limits: One paired observation is not p95 or proof of total startup improvement.
Node startup differed between observations; total workspace times were effectively unchanged.
Complete inventory arrives after workspace rather than before. Both readiness times are reported.
Hidden process sampling is not visible input/frame acceptance or a complete process-start trace.
The 3 second total workspace target remains unmet.

unchangedHostFindings.decision: Do not replace Host resolution, disable plugins, or change A2 composition for these small or contract-sensitive costs.
